reply.text: {"say":"Legs on the smith machine, as much of it as the rack allows: squat, Romanian deadlift, split squat, hip thrust, and calves.","title":"Smith Machine Legs","days":[{"name":"Smith Machine Legs","exercises":[{"key":"smith-machine-back-squat","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace hard before each rep."},{"key":"smith-machine-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the bar close to your legs."},{"key":"smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Rear foot on the bench, torso upright."},{"key":"smith-machine-hip-thrust","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause and squeeze glutes at the top."},{"key":"smith-machine-calf-raise","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full stretch at the bottom."}]}],"unmet":[]}
